summary: Only an OpenStreetMap point called Fire Tower near Starkville, MS. Not matched to any register entry; may duplicate the Maben or Oktibbeha tower. Standing status unconfirmed.

facts.status_note: No source we read confirms that a tower stands at this map point.

events.note: OpenStreetMap point named Fire Tower; its version 3 edit comment reads outlook_tower to observation. The page gives the edit only as almost 13 years ago, so 2013 is our estimate.

notes_for_editor: Identity unconfirmed. The OSM point is 2.7 km from the Maben register coordinates and about 9.9 km from Oktibbeha, so it may be a mis-placed duplicate of one of them, or a different structure. The 2020 state list has no Fire Tower entry for Oktibbeha County. The story may not be worth publishing as a lookout history until someone confirms the point. Searches: 2 WebSearch. Page reads: 4 distinct.
